Bug_Title: DMI: Bad constant value for month (DMI_BAD_MONTH)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a constant month
value outside the expected range of 0..11 to a method.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is present because the month value passed to the Calendar.set() method is 12, which is outside the valid range of 0 (January) to 11 (December) for months.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls showBug from BadMonthExample which triggers the bug by using a month value of 12 in Calendar.set(), outside the valid range of 0 to 11.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully without any errors or failures, suggesting that the bug was not triggered.
